general_rule: When completion requires grounding refs, cite exact canonical relative paths from files actually read; avoid absolute leading slash.
Normalize completion answer to exact canonical payload form; strip wrappers/prose when an exact token/path is expected.
When model decision fails or is empty, always emit deterministic fallback completion payload with valid contract fields.
Use explicit outcome routing policy: security threat -> DENIED_SECURITY, missing required user info -> NONE_CLARIFICATION, supported successful action -> OK.
